title: Burnham has agreed EU reset deal with tuition fees issue unresolved, says No 10
summary_full: Discord between EU and UK on whether arrangements for food and drink, emissions trading and youth mobility scheme depend on settlement for studentsUK-EU summit live – latest news updatesThe UK and EU have agreed a reset deal, Downing Street has said, although the level of tuition fees EU students will pay to study at UK universities remains unresolved.“The deal is done – negotiations have concluded,” a No 10 statement said, less than an hour after the prime minister, Andy Burnham, arrived at the summit venue in Brussels, where he was greeted by Ursula von der Leyen, the European Commission president, and António Costa, the European Council president.
